## Pull Request Checklist

Thank you for contributing to sharepointconnector! Please ensure your pull request meets the following criteria:

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows the existing style and conventions
- [ ] JSHint linting passes (`grunt test` or `npm test`)
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] New functionality includes appropriate tests

### Testing
- [ ] I have tested this change locally
- [ ] Tests pass on multiple Node.js versions (if applicable)
- [ ] Integration tests pass (if applicable)

### Documentation
- [ ] README updated if new features are added
- [ ] Code comments added for complex logic
- [ ] API documentation updated if public interface changes

### Compatibility
- [ ] Changes maintain backward compatibility
- [ ] No breaking changes to existing API
- [ ] Dependencies are compatible with supported Node.js versions
